Session date: 4:06 pm on 23 January, 2023
[D1:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
[D1:2] Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
[D1:3] Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
[D1:4] Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
[D1:5] Deborah: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair
[D1:6] Jolene: Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
[D1:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a bench and a window
[D1:7] Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
[D1:8] Jolene: Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it
[D1:9] Deborah: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?
[D1:10] Jolene: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
[D1:11] Deborah: It should really give you strength and energy!
[D1:12] Jolene: Do you have goals?
[D1:13] Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
[D1:14] Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
[D1:15] Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
[D1:16] Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
[D1:17] Deborah: Gotta run, bye!
[D1:18] Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!
Session date: 9:49 am on 27 January, 2023
[D2:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.
[D2:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch
[D2:2] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
[D2:3] Deborah: Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
[D2:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture
[D2:4] Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
[D2:5] Deborah: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
[D2:6] Jolene: What do you value in your relationship?
[D2:7] Deborah: It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday!
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper
[D2:8] Jolene: What touching words! Who is this letter from?
[D2:9] Deborah: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.
[D2:10] Jolene: Where do you most often do yoga?
[D2:11] Deborah: This is one of the places where I do it.
[D2:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a television and a window
[D2:12] Jolene: Where is it?
[D2:13] Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
[D2:14] Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.
[D2:15] Deborah: Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a window seat in a room with a window
[D2:16] Jolene: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?
[D2:17] Deborah: Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house. 
[D2:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window
[D2:18] Jolene: What other hobbies did your mother have?
[D2:19] Deborah: Travel was also her great passion!
[D2:20] Jolene: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.
[D2:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it
[D2:21] Deborah: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?
[D2:22] Jolene:  I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!
[D2:22] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket
[D2:23] Deborah: Awww, that's so nice! 
[D2:24] Jolene: I bought it a year ago in Paris.
[D2:25] Deborah: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!
[D2:26] Jolene: They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!
[D2:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv
[D2:27] Deborah: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?
[D2:28] Jolene: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.
[D2:29] Deborah: Do you only play old games or try new ones?
[D2:30] Jolene: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.
[D2:31] Deborah: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!
[D2:32] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!
Session date: 7:03 pm on 1 February, 2023
[D3:1] Jolene: Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve.
[D3:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop
[D3:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?
[D3:3] Jolene: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:42] Deborah: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!

Session date: 9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023
[D5:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
[D5:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
[D5:3] Jolene: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
[D5:4] Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
[D5:5] Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
[D5:6] Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
[D5:7] Jolene:  Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
[D5:8] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?
[D5:9] Jolene: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.
[D5:10] Deborah: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?
[D5:11] Jolene: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!
[D5:12] Deborah: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
[D5:13] Jolene: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
[D5:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes
[D5:14] Deborah: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
[D5:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
[D5:16] Deborah: You're awesome too! Take care!
[D5:17] Jolene: Stay safe!
Session date: 4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023
[D6:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You?
[D6:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine
[D6:2] Deborah: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.
[D6:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a garden with a bunch of flowers in buckets
[D6:3] Jolene: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.
[D6:4] Deborah: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
[D6:5] Jolene: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
[D6:6] Deborah: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
[D6:7] Jolene: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.
[D6:8] Deborah: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile.
[D6:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women are riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road
[D6:9] Jolene: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?
[D6:10] Deborah: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.
[D6:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky
[D6:11] Jolene: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.
[D6:12] Deborah: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!
[D6:13] Jolene: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!
[D6:14] Deborah: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!
[D6:15] Jolene: I'll keep you posted if I decide to go there.
[D6:16] Deborah: Take care!
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:1] Jolene: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.
[D7:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
[D7:3] Jolene: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo.
[D7:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose
[D7:4] Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
[D7:5] Jolene: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo.
[D7:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them
[D7:6] Deborah: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?
[D7:7] Jolene: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
[D7:8] Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
[D7:9] Jolene: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great!
[D7:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book and a calculator on a table
[D7:10] Deborah: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
[D7:11] Jolene: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it.
[D7:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building
[D7:12] Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
[D7:13] Jolene: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
[D7:14] Deborah: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
[D7:15] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.

[D17:3] Deborah: It's amazing how it can give you peace and calm in times like that. If you ever need any support, just let me know - we're in this together!
[D17:4] Jolene:  Appreciate your support! BTW, I wanted to share this with you.
[D17:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip
[D17:5] Deborah: Your creativity is amazing! 
[D17:6] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry. I think they turned out really cool!
[D17:7] Deborah: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing! Does that usually inspire your engineering projects too?

[D17:12] Jolene: My aim is to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system. It'll help with responding to emergencies and monitoring the environment. It'll make the world a better, safer place.
[D17:13] Deborah: I love your commitment. Keep going!
[D17:14] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing and doing my best to make a difference.
[D17:15] Deborah: You got this!
Session date: 2:58 pm on 16 August, 2023
[D18:1] Jolene: Been thinking a lot about my plans lately, especially after checking in with my bf. It's been up and down!  Some days it feels like I'm trying to juggle my engineering, relationship, and growing as a person, and I just don't know how to handle it all. How do you manage when it's too much?
[D18:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a checklist on it
[D18:2] Deborah: Finding ways to restore balance is important. Taking time for yourself and recognizing your needs can make a difference. 
[D18:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a moss wall and a floor cushion
[D18:3] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.
[D18:4] Deborah:  It's great to hear that it's been helping you out!
[D18:5] Jolene:  Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list. Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes.
[D18:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a quote on it
[D18:6] Deborah: I love this quote. So uplifting. Does it motivate you when you see it?
[D18:7] Jolene: Yeah, it's like a little reminder to stick to my goals and never give up.
[D18:8] Deborah: Gotcha! Visual reminders like this photo can be super motivating. Keep focusing on your goals, Jolene, and don't give up! I led a meditation yoga sessionto the elderly at a local care home last week during sunset. Nature can be really helpful for finding peace. Have you tried mindfulness too? 
[D18:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people doing yoga on a beach
[D18:9] Jolene: Haven't tried it yet, but I'm keen to give it a shot. That sounds really peaceful. I could use some of that calm in my life right now.  I'm interested in destressing and trying mindfulness. 
[D18:10] Deborah: I started with workshops and books, and now mindfulness is a huge part of my life.
[D18:11] Jolene:  I'll definitely look into some of it. Can't wait to get started!
[D18:12] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! I'm so glad you're willing to try some mindfulness. It can be really helpful. Let me know if you need any help getting started - I'm happy to assist you with your journey!
[D18:13] Jolene:  I really appreciate it.
[D18:14] Deborah: We're in this together. Give me a shout if you need anything. Bye for now.
[D18:15] Jolene: Thanks, I'll hit you up if I need anything. Bye for now.
Session date: 12:52 am on 19 August, 2023
[D19:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?
[D19:2] Jolene: Life's been hella busy since we last talked. I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.! Engineering studies are still going strong too. Balance has been key for me lately. How about you? What's been up?
[D19:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a black xbox console with a yoda yoda figure next to it
[D19:3] Deborah:  Well done! As for me, I've been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with the community. Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.
[D19:4] Jolene:  Was it rewarding seeing everyone come together? Can you tell me more about how you put it together? Also, any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?
[D19:5] Deborah:  I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing! As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.
[D19:6] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! Gonna make a plan to manage my studies and hobbies. Say, do you ever play video games?
[D19:7] Deborah: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while. It's a good way to relax after a busy day. Do you have any game suggestions? What's your favorite game?

[D30:17] Deborah: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
[D30:18] Jolene: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!
